summary.name: AIPRM
summary.one_liner: AIPRM is a browser-based prompt library and manager that adds reusable, community-reviewed prompts on top of ChatGPT.
use_cases: Finding ready-made prompts for SEO and writing tasks
Saving and organizing your own ChatGPT prompts
Sharing prompt templates with a team
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a library of over 4,000 community prompts that are reviewed and approved by the AIPRM community. Users can create private prompts, organize them for reuse, and share them with their team. It offers a Custom GPT section for browsing and managing prompts for each Custom GPT. The page states AIPRM works on top of ChatGPT and other AI models, and it lists public and private prompt counts (5,400+ public, 345,000+ private) and over 2 million users.
notable: Community-reviewed library of over 4,000 ChatGPT prompts
Custom GPT integration for browsing and managing prompts per GPT
Private prompt creation and team sharing
caveats: The page says you can start for FREE but does not list paid tier details or prices
Platform details beyond ChatGPT usage are not specified on the page
